templates.ots_listener_shoulders: Framing: over-the-listener shoulders from behind/side; foreground shoulder and back-of-head softly out of focus; primary speaker sharp in three-quarter toward the listener eyeline—not into lens; period camp light; quiet breathing in silences.
templates.ots_partner_silhouette: Framing: primary speaker favored; partner as dark shoulder or silhouette on opposite frame edge facing the speaker; campfire or open sky separation; keep partner face mostly hidden or unreadable so lip-sync reads on the primary only.
templates.medium_neutral_hold: Framing: medium shot, neutral shoulders-up; eyes toward lens or slight three-quarter; minimal head motion during silences; steady breathing.
templates.waist_up_reflective: Framing: waist-up in frame when possible; reflective stillness before speaking; hands quiet at sides or one gesture held.
templates.intimate_confession: Framing: closer medium; softer eye-line (not direct stare); allow micro-expressions during pre-speech hold.
templates.directive_orders: Framing: stable medium; chin level; clear forward eye-line; crisp onset when speech begins after a short still hold.
